name: OpenLibrary
description: Provides book and author metadata from OpenLibrary.org for your Jellyfin book libraries. Automatically fetches book descriptions, series information, publication dates, genres, and author biographies from the OpenLibrary API.

versions.changelog:
Initial release
- Book metadata provider
- Author/person metadata provider
- Support for book descriptions, series, genres, and publication dates
- Support for author biographies and birth/death dates
Add image and metadata fetching for Book and Person and metadata fetching for audiobook
